rationale: User approved 11-23: L2 (Wigner LBTE) on the top 5 r6 structures by kappa_L1 (BC6N x2, BC2N x3, 615-703 W/mK); diamond-like phases can have LBTE/RTA 1.1-1.9, so the ranking needs the L2 check.

relax.optimizer.ref: matbench-discovery KappaSettings, protocol phonondb-v1 (commit 2b7bff9, 2026-10-19; Pota et al. arXiv:2408.00755)

relax.cell_filter.ref: matbench-discovery KappaSettings, protocol phonondb-v1 (commit 2b7bff9, 2026-10-19; Pota et al. arXiv:2408.00755)

relax.fmax.ref: matbench-discovery KappaSettings, protocol phonondb-v1 (commit 2b7bff9, 2026-10-19; Pota et al. arXiv:2408.00755)

relax.max_steps.ref: matbench-discovery KappaSettings, protocol phonondb-v1 (commit 2b7bff9, 2026-10-19; Pota et al. arXiv:2408.00755)

relax.relaxation_mode.ref: matbench-discovery KappaSettings, protocol phonondb-v1 (commit 2b7bff9, 2026-10-19; Pota et al. arXiv:2408.00755); two-stage = constrained then unconstrained, keep stage 1 if the space group changes

relax.enforce_symmetry.ref: matbench-discovery KappaSettings, protocol phonondb-v1 (commit 2b7bff9, 2026-10-19; Pota et al. arXiv:2408.00755) (FixSymmetry, no-tilt cell mask)

relax.relax_symprec.ref: matbench-discovery KappaSettings, protocol phonondb-v1 (commit 2b7bff9, 2026-10-19; Pota et al. arXiv:2408.00755) (FixSymmetry symprec)

relax.symprec.ref: matbench-discovery KappaSettings, protocol phonondb-v1 (commit 2b7bff9, 2026-10-19; Pota et al. arXiv:2408.00755) (space-group detection; spglib here)

relax.dtype.ref: configs/models.yaml per model, resolved at submission (decided 11-04): float64 by default (k_SRME runs MACE in float64); PET-OAM-XL float32 (42-rotation symmetrizer 45 s -> 4.7 s per 64-atom force call on L40S, max force change 1.1e-5 eV/A; checked on c-BN in S0)

kappa.displacement.ref: matbench-discovery models/*/*.yml kappa settings of DPA-4.1-Max-OAM, TECE-OAM-RRA-1.0, PET-OAM-XL, NequIP-OAM-L (displacement 0.03 A; commit c70947f); also the phononDB-LTC DFT value used at L4b. MACE-MPA-0's leaderboard run used 0.01 A (override for a like-for-like kappa_SRME of MACE)

kappa.is_plusminus.ref: matbench-discovery KappaSettings, protocol phonondb-v1 (commit 2b7bff9, 2026-10-19; Pota et al. arXiv:2408.00755)

kappa.symprec.ref: matbench-discovery KappaSettings, protocol phonondb-v1 (commit 2b7bff9, 2026-10-19; Pota et al. arXiv:2408.00755)

kappa.temperatures.ref: matbench-discovery KappaSettings, protocol phonondb-v1 (commit 2b7bff9, 2026-10-19; Pota et al. arXiv:2408.00755)

kappa.use_reference_settings.ref: kappa_SRME: phononDB entries carry their own fc2/fc3 supercells and q-mesh; used whenever a structure has them

kappa.fc3_min_width.ref: heuristic: calibrated on phononDB-PBE choices for light-element entries (docs/mcp_servers_plan.md §2.2); validate with submit_mlip_convergence

kappa.fc2_min_width.ref: heuristic: calibrated on phononDB-PBE choices for light-element entries (docs/mcp_servers_plan.md §2.2); validate with submit_mlip_convergence
kappa.fc2_min_width.reason: FC2 width scan 11-14: 12 A within 4 % of 14 A (same kappa params as r6 L1 -> FC cache hit); chunk/time execution only

kappa.q_mesh_length.ref: heuristic: calibrated on phononDB-PBE choices for light-element entries (docs/mcp_servers_plan.md §2.2); validate with submit_mlip_convergence

kappa.transport.ref: matbench-discovery thermal_conductivity.calculate_conductivity (commit 2b7bff9); requires phono3py==3.30.0 on the worker

kappa.kappa_if_symmetry_broken.ref: matbench-discovery KappaSettings, protocol phonondb-v1 (commit 2b7bff9, 2026-10-19; Pota et al. arXiv:2408.00755) (conductivity_broken_symm)

kappa.chunk_size.ref: execution only (does not change results); structures per job: one L1 structure takes 0.1-10 GPU h, so a chunk of 4 ran a round's 3 large cells serially (~26 h instead of ~10 h, 11-14)

lbte.temperatures.ref: matbench-discovery KappaSettings, protocol phonondb-v1 (commit 2b7bff9, 2026-10-19; Pota et al. arXiv:2408.00755)

lbte.max_collision_matrix_gb.ref: execution limit: the q-mesh is reduced until the collision matrix fits; the reduction is recorded

lbte.min_mesh_scale.ref: heuristic: below half the L1 mesh the LBTE/RTA ratio is not trusted

resources.time.reason: FC2 width scan 11-14: 12 A within 4 % of 14 A (same kappa params as r6 L1 -> FC cache hit); chunk/time execution only

resources.nodelist.ref: execution only (does not change results); one node, e.g. 'a-a100-o-1' (A100-SXM4-80GB): the GPU partitions mix 40 and 80 GB cards and 512-atom supercells do not fit 48 GB (configs/models.yaml)

resources.exclude_nodes.ref: execution only (does not change results); comma-separated node names

resources.mem.ref: execution only (does not change results); host memory per job, Slurm --mem (e.g. '200G'); unset = the partition default per CPU. L3 needs >= 2x the FC4 estimate (MLIPFc4Params.max_fc4_gb)
